baseline.tools: public web search allowed; shell/file/agent tools forbidden
assumptions: Chosen format: 1920×1080 with a 24-second guided approach and interior camera tour.
The five-storey pagoda and garden are fictional, stylized architectural designs, not a reconstruction of a specific building.
Interactive navigation uses WASD, mouse or touch dragging, Q/E for camera height, and numbered floor destinations. It is a free-camera exploration rather than a physical walking simulation.
Artwork is generated entirely with Canvas and editable geometry. No external assets, product facts, named fonts, or asset licenses are required. The harness supplies gsap.min.js.
User interaction overrides the guided camera until Tour view is selected. Without interaction, animation is determined by the single paused GSAP timeline.
The HTML has not been rendered or visually reviewed.
baseline.summary: Standalone 3D pagoda with five explorable floors, curved roofs, lanterns, balconies, a spiral staircase, garden scenery, and interactive camera controls.
baseline.reason: Rendered and technically checked. Matched-time visual review pending.
